post.summary: Create SO products by racks for a stock opname session
post.description: Post the scanned products associated with one rack. Each item identifies its product by barcode (scanned) or plu (catalog). Idempotent: re-posting the same rack upserts per (rak_id, plu) instead of conflicting, so retries after local edits are safe.

barcode.description: Scanned barcode. Either barcode or plu is required.

plu.description: Product PLU. Either barcode or plu is required.

message.example: Stock opname by rack created successfully

post.description: Upsert products + barcodes from a PRODUK.DBF ("produk") and BARCODE.DBF ("barcode") multipart pair. Idempotent. Use ?dry_run=true to validate without writing.
Removes ALL products, barcodes and tombstones. Requires ?confirm=true. Stock opname history is untouched.

barcode.description: Primary barcode (first barcode of the product)

barcodes.description: Replaces the whole barcode set when present.
